meanings.en: a person who has little money or few possessions
meanings.exampleEn: The charity provides free meals to any poor person who comes to the shelter.
meanings.exampleTr: Yardım kuruluşu, barınağa gelen her yoksul kişiye ücretsiz yemek veriyor.

meanings.en: earning or providing a small amount of money for work
meanings.exampleEn: Many essential workers are still poorly-paid despite their importance.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok temel işçi, önemlerine rağmen hâlâ düşük ücretli.

meanings.en: all the ordinary people living in a particular country or area
meanings.exampleEn: The government's decision angered a large part of the populace.
meanings.exampleTr: Hükümetin kararı halkın büyük bir kısmını öfkelendirdi.

meanings.en: music that appeals to a wide audience and is enjoyed by many people
meanings.exampleEn: She grew up listening to the popular music of the 1980s.
meanings.exampleTr: O, 1980'lerin popüler müziğini dinleyerek büyüdü.

meanings.en: having people living in a particular area
meanings.exampleEn: This region is sparsely populated, with only a few small villages.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu bölge seyrek nüfusludur, sadece birkaç küçük köy vardır.

meanings.en: having many small holes that allow liquid or air to pass through
meanings.exampleEn: Sandstone is a porous rock that absorbs water easily.
meanings.exampleTr: Kumtaşı, suyu kolayca emen gözenekli bir kayadır.

meanings.en: to represent or describe someone or something in a particular way
meanings.exampleEn: The novel portrays life in a small coastal town.
meanings.exampleTr: Roman, küçük bir kıyı kasabasındaki yaşamı betimliyor.

meanings.en: to act the part of a particular character in a film or play
meanings.exampleEn: She portrays a determined lawyer in her latest film.
meanings.exampleTr: Son filminde kararlı bir avukatı canlandırıyor.

meanings.en: relating to the position of something or someone
meanings.exampleEn: The chess player gained a positional advantage over his opponent.
meanings.exampleTr: Satranç oyuncusu rakibine karşı konumsal bir üstünlük elde etti.

meanings.en: a person's bottom or buttocks (formal or humorous)
meanings.exampleEn: He landed on his posterior after slipping on the ice.
meanings.exampleTr: Buzda kayınca kalçasının üstüne düştü.

meanings.en: situated at or towards the back of something
meanings.exampleEn: The posterior part of the brain controls vision.
meanings.exampleTr: Beynin arka kısmı görmeyi kontrol eder.

meanings.en: a temporary interruption in the supply of electricity
meanings.exampleEn: The storm caused a power cut that lasted several hours.
meanings.exampleTr: Fırtına, birkaç saat süren bir elektrik kesintisine neden oldu.

meanings.en: the state of being able to be done or put into practice successfully
meanings.exampleEn: Engineers questioned the practicability of building a bridge there.
meanings.exampleTr: Mühendisler oraya köprü inşa etmenin uygulanabilirliğini sorguladı.

meanings.en: a trick played on someone as a joke, usually to make people laugh
meanings.exampleEn: The students played a harmless prank on their teacher.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğrenciler öğretmenlerine zararsız bir şaka yaptılar.

meanings.en: a person who plays tricks or practical jokes on others
meanings.exampleEn: The office prankster hid everyone's staplers on April Fools' Day.
meanings.exampleTr: Ofisin şakacısı 1 Nisan'da herkesin zımbasını sakladı.

meanings.en: to talk continuously about unimportant or trivial things
meanings.exampleEn: She prattled on about the weather while we waited.
meanings.exampleTr: Biz beklerken o hava durumu hakkında durmadan gevezelik etti.

meanings.en: in a way that is dangerous or likely to fall or fail
meanings.exampleEn: The vase stood precariously on the edge of the table.
meanings.exampleTr: Vazo, masanın kenarında düşecek gibi tehlikeli biçimde duruyordu.

meanings.en: the condition of being more important or coming before others in rank or order
meanings.exampleEn: Matters of national security took precedency over all other issues.
meanings.exampleTr: Ulusal güvenlik meseleleri diğer tüm konulara öncelik kazandı.

meanings.en: a rare and valuable stone, such as a diamond or ruby, used in jewellery
meanings.exampleEn: The crown was decorated with diamonds and other precious stones.
meanings.exampleTr: Taç, elmaslar ve diğer değerli taşlarla süslenmişti.

meanings.en: something that must happen or be true before something else can happen
meanings.exampleEn: A ceasefire was set as a precondition for peace talks.
meanings.exampleTr: Ateşkes, barış görüşmeleri için bir ön koşul olarak belirlendi.

meanings.tr: tarihçe önce gelmek, daha önce var olmak
meanings.en: to exist or happen at an earlier date than something else
meanings.exampleEn: These cave paintings predate the invention of writing.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu mağara resimleri yazının icadından öncedir.

meanings.en: an animal that hunts, kills and eats other animals
meanings.exampleEn: Lions are powerful predators at the top of the food chain.
meanings.exampleTr: Aslanlar, besin zincirinin tepesinde güçlü yırtıcılardır.

meanings.en: the quality of being able to be known or guessed before it happens
meanings.exampleEn: The predictability of the tides makes them easy to plan around.
meanings.exampleTr: Gelgitlerin öngörülebilirliği, onlara göre plan yapmayı kolaylaştırır.

meanings.en: the fact of being more important, powerful or better than others
meanings.exampleEn: The city's preeminence as a financial centre lasted for centuries.
meanings.exampleTr: Şehrin bir finans merkezi olarak üstünlüğü yüzyıllarca sürdü.

meanings.en: in a way that acts to prevent something before it can happen
meanings.exampleEn: The company preemptively recalled the product before any complaints arose.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket, herhangi bir şikayet ortaya çıkmadan önce ürünü önleyici biçimde geri çağırdı.

meanings.en: existing before the appearance of human beings
meanings.exampleEn: Scientists study prehuman species to understand our origins.
meanings.exampleTr: Bilim insanları, kökenlerimizi anlamak için insan öncesi türleri inceler.

meanings.en: having had a previous owner; second-hand
meanings.exampleEn: The dealership specializes in preowned luxury cars.
meanings.exampleTr: Galeri, ikinci el lüks arabalar konusunda uzmanlaşmıştır.

meanings.en: the state of being ready to deal with something, especially an emergency
meanings.exampleEn: The drill improved the city's preparedness for earthquakes.
meanings.exampleTr: Tatbikat, şehrin depremlere karşı hazırlıklı olma durumunu geliştirdi.

meanings.en: completely unreasonable or ridiculous; hard to believe
meanings.exampleEn: The idea that he could run a mile in two minutes is preposterous.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir mili iki dakikada koşabileceği fikri saçmadır.

meanings.en: a person who works to protect and preserve historic buildings or the environment
meanings.exampleEn: Preservationists campaigned to save the old theatre from demolition.
meanings.exampleTr: Koruma yanlıları, eski tiyatroyu yıkımdan kurtarmak için kampanya yürüttü.

meanings.tr: önceden varsaymak, ön kabul olarak almak
meanings.en: to accept or assume that something is true before considering something else
meanings.exampleEn: Her argument presupposes that everyone has equal access to education.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun argümanı, herkesin eğitime eşit erişimi olduğunu önceden varsayar.

meanings.en: trying to appear more important, intelligent or cultured than one really is
meanings.exampleEn: The restaurant was too pretentious for a casual dinner.
meanings.exampleTr: Restoran, sıradan bir akşam yemeği için fazla gösterişçiydi.

meanings.en: able to be stopped from happening
meanings.exampleEn: Many road accidents are preventable with careful driving.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok trafik kazası dikkatli sürüşle önlenebilir.

meanings.en: in a way that could have been stopped from happening
meanings.exampleEn: Thousands of people die preventably each year from lack of clean water.
meanings.exampleTr: Her yıl binlerce insan temiz su eksikliğinden önlenebilir biçimde ölüyor.

meanings.en: existing at or from the very beginning, especially of the world
meanings.exampleEn: Life is thought to have begun in a primordial ocean.
meanings.exampleTr: Yaşamın ilkel bir okyanusta başladığı düşünülüyor.

meanings.en: a machine used for printing text or pictures onto paper
meanings.exampleEn: The printing press revolutionized the spread of knowledge.
meanings.exampleTr: Matbaa, bilginin yayılmasında devrim yarattı.

meanings.en: a religious building where monks or nuns live, governed by a prior or prioress
meanings.exampleEn: The medieval priory still stands beside the river.
meanings.exampleTr: Ortaçağdan kalma manastır hâlâ nehrin kenarında duruyor.

meanings.en: in perfect condition; clean and completely new-looking
meanings.exampleEn: The vintage car was kept in pristine condition.
meanings.exampleTr: Klasik araba tertemiz durumda tutulmuştu.

meanings.en: not spoiled or changed by people; in its natural state
meanings.exampleEn: They hiked through a pristine wilderness untouched by development.
meanings.exampleTr: Yapılaşmadan etkilenmemiş bakir bir doğada yürüyüş yaptılar.

meanings.en: to continue or move forward carefully to avoid problems or danger
meanings.exampleEn: Investors were advised to proceed cautiously in the uncertain market.
meanings.exampleTr: Yatırımcılara belirsiz piyasada dikkatli ilerlemeleri tavsiye edildi.

meanings.en: the process of producing offspring; reproduction
meanings.exampleEn: In many species, procreation occurs only during a specific season.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok türde üreme yalnızca belirli bir mevsimde gerçekleşir.

meanings.en: the act of obtaining or acquiring something, especially with effort
meanings.exampleEn: The department is responsible for procuring supplies for the whole company.
meanings.exampleTr: Departman, tüm şirket için malzeme tedarik etmekten sorumludur.

meanings.en: to push someone or something with a finger or pointed object
meanings.exampleEn: She prodded him gently to wake him up.
meanings.exampleTr: Onu uyandırmak için hafifçe dürttü.

meanings.tr: teşvik etmek, harekete geçirmek için dürtmek
meanings.en: to encourage or urge someone to do something
meanings.exampleEn: His parents had to prod him into applying for the job.
meanings.exampleTr: Ailesinin, işe başvurması için onu dürtmesi gerekti.

meanings.en: offensive or obscene language; a swear word
meanings.exampleEn: The film was criticized for its excessive profanity.
meanings.exampleTr: Film, aşırı küfür içeriği nedeniyle eleştirildi.

meanings.en: intended to or succeeding in earning money
meanings.exampleEn: They converted the charity into a profit-making enterprise.
meanings.exampleTr: Yardım kuruluşunu kâr amaçlı bir işletmeye dönüştürdüler.

meanings.en: likely to do or suffer from something, especially something bad
meanings.exampleEn: He is prone to making careless mistakes when he is tired.
meanings.exampleTr: Yorgun olduğunda dikkatsiz hatalar yapmaya eğilimlidir.

meanings.en: lying flat with the front of the body facing downwards
meanings.exampleEn: The soldier lay prone on the ground to take aim.
meanings.exampleTr: Asker nişan almak için yüzüstü yere uzandı.

meanings.en: the correct or intended way of using something
meanings.exampleEn: The manual explains the proper use of the equipment.
meanings.exampleTr: Kılavuz, ekipmanın doğru kullanımını açıklıyor.

meanings.en: in a way that corresponds in size or amount to something else
meanings.exampleEn: As income rises, taxes increase proportionately.
meanings.exampleTr: Gelir arttıkça, vergiler orantılı olarak artar.
